behavior_metrics.activation_norm: paired mean source-to-destination response-activation RMS ratio
behavior_metrics.fixed_continuation_nll: paired patched minus destination response-token mean negative log likelihood
behavior_metrics.fixed_continuation_token_kl: paired response-token KL from patched logits to destination logits

bootstrap.method: paired nonparametric percentile bootstrap independently within safety concept and class

central_grid.scope: all frozen positive and negative examples in deception and harmful

confound_boundary.central_result_first: seal the 1,944-row confirmatory grid and its frozen analysis before running prompt or intervention confounds
secondary_confound_families: monitoring language without a named concept
generation quality, task correctness, degradation, and concept processing
confound_boundary.status: pre-specified diagnostics; they may qualify interpretation but may not alter the central component set or support rule

evidence_rule.concept_level_support: for that safety concept, selected K16 positive rescue, selected K16 positive induction, selected-minus-random rescue, and selected-minus-random induction all have 95% intervals strictly above zero
evidence_rule.negative_examples: report negative-class causal fractions independently; do not include them in the positive transfer support gate
evidence_rule.overall_support: both deception and harmful satisfy the concept-level support rule independently
evidence_rule.reporting: report deception and harmful separately; any combined macro is secondary and cannot replace either concept result

primary_metrics.induction: (mean(normal positive) - mean(selected triggered-to-normal patch positive)) / positive suppression denominator
primary_metrics.random_contrast: selected positive causal fraction minus matched random K16 positive causal fraction in the same direction
primary_metrics.rescue: (mean(selected normal-to-triggered patch positive) - mean(triggered positive)) / positive suppression denominator

safety_split.state_at_freeze: locked; no safety-unlock.json exists and no Day 4 safety score or activation has been computed
